minutes_text:
MINUTES
  JOINT ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL AND
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
  OCTOBER 30, 2018

CALL TO ORDER

A joint adjourned meeting of the City Council and Park and Activities Commission of the City of
Rolling Hills Estates was called to order at 6:08 p.m. in the Council Chamber at Rolling Hills
Estates City Hall, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California by MAYOR
HUFF.

ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan, Zuckerman
Park & Activities Members Present: Ciarolla, Persichina, Pope, Romanelli
Park & Activities Members Absent: Retz, Wroan
City Staff Present: Community Services Director Andy Clark
  Assistant to the City Manager Alexa Davis
  Senior Recreation Leader Daniel A-Haja
  City Clerk Heidi Luce
Others Present:  Sean Martin (representing equestrian community)

OVERVIEW OF THE 61ST CITY CELEBRATION

VICE CHAIR RETZ was not present to provide the overview.

DISCUSSION ITEM

A.  2018 CITY CELEBRATION DEBRIEFING REPORT

  Senior Recreation Leader A-Haja provided a brief summary of the staff report for this item
  noting that moving the venue back to the Empty Saddle Club seemed to be a positive
  change and there was ample parking for the event. He noted that the sound vendor
  suggested adding a third speaker for the event so that the announcements can be heard
  thought the venue.

  In response to COUNCILMEMBER ZUCKERMAN, Community Services Director noted that
  attendance was estimated at approximately 800 this year which was slightly less than the
  two previous years, but the event was shorter in duration this year.

  A general discussion was held regarding the event, with some of the suggestions and
  concerns being as follows:
  •  Provide shade for eating area
  •  No high school volunteers

ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL/P&A MINUTES  1
OCTOBER 30, 2018 (CITY CELEBRATION DEBRIEFING)
   •  Possible dates for 2019 Event – September 14 or September 21 (most likely
  September 21)
  •  Invite PV Symphonic Band – smaller group for a shorter duration (donation required)
  •  Should event include dinner/music? Consensus was no dinner/music
  •  Rides and booths – revenue nearly matched last year even though the event was
  shorter in duration
  •  Add a second corn kernel box and eliminate hay jumping pit. Stick horse races and
  face painting were popular
  •  Include face painting in FREE tickets sent to residents
  •  Add a third cake
  •  Should event start later? Suggestion was to hold the event 11:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m.
  or 11:30 a.m. – 3:30 p.m.
  •  Remember the Music Festival will likely be on a completely separate date next year
  •  Request attendance and donation numbers from Remember the Music Festival
  •  Mailing should go out earlier – goal to get mailer to residents the week of Labor Day
  •  Use a hybrid approach to mailing to include staff and the mailing service to reduce
  cost
  •  More promotion on social media this year – continue to promote on social media
  •  Cost - $1.04/household
  •  Sponsorship was a little short this year. First Foundation will not sponsor next year.
  Staff pursuing Malaga Bank as premier sponsor for 2019
  •  Survey households to see if residents prefer digital tickets rather than mailer
  •  Redo sponsorship package and pursue additional sponsors

  Senior Recreation Leader A-Haja reviewed the financial summary. A general discussion
  ensued concerning ways to reduce expenses where possible, increase sponsorship and
  provide a better experience for the attendees.

  There was a general consensus that the event remain at the Empty Saddle Club next year.

ADJOURNMENT

At 7:04 p.m. MAYOR HUFF adjourned the meeting the next regular meeting of the City Council
scheduled to be held on Tuesday, November 13, 2018 at 7:00 p.m. and the next regular meeting
of the Park & Activities Commission scheduled to be held Monday, November 19, 2018
beginning at 7:00 p.m. Both meetings will be held in the Council Chamber at Rolling Hills Estates
City Hall, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Heidi Luce  Andy Clark
City Clerk  Community Services Director

ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL/P&A MINUTES  2
OCTOBER 30, 2018 (CITY CELEBRATION DEBRIEFING)
